Best,

Thanks for starting this, Steph. A couple of notes after skimming your doc:
- I pulled out the stretch goals into a separate tab in the calibration sheet so we can rate impact vs. scope consistently across managers.
- Recommend removing any salary/projection wording from the shared doc and keeping compensation discussions to private HR threads.
- I'll schedule a 30-min pre-calibration with you and Marissa next week to align scoring rubrics.

I've attached the updated calibration sheet (see tab "scoring_v1"). Also included a clean PDF of the manager write-up (lattice_review_draft.pdf) with inline comments rather than tracked changes — easier for HR to copy to the official form.

Appreciate the heads up. A few principles for calibration:
1) Keep manager narratives factual and evidence-based (link to 2–3 outcomes).
2) Any promotion recommendations should include a proposed role profile and a capacity plan.
3) No docs containing promotion/comp language leave the internal leadership+HR thread until we sign off.

Laura — please surface the calibration matrix in the meeting and mark which items are tie-breakers.

Vivek
VP Engineering | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
